meta.name: NEXUS Canonical Corpus
meta.purpose: Fingerprint of the actual files that produced the Omniscience AGENTS.md. Acts as the canonical input for the Forge Protocol.
meta.compiler_note: The corpus is descriptive, not prescriptive. Files are fingerprinted by their actual content; the Forge decides how to consume them.

schema.file_id: Hash of the file content (sha1, first 12 chars)
schema.role: What this file was in the chain (claude_raw, technical_target, master_assembly, etc.)
schema.weight: 0.0-1.0 — relative importance as observed in the final Omniscience AGENTS.md
schema.preserved_verbatim: Boolean — was the content kept as-is or transformed?
schema.transformation_notes: What the agent did to this file (merged, distilled, replaced, deleted)

files.transformation_notes: First attempt at consolidating all components. Contains the early CORE ANCHOR + SOVEREIGNTY DOCTRINE + Soul Print system. Was the substrate. Most of its core identity lines survived into Omniscience. Soul Print section was preserved almost intact in ULTIMATE_MASTER Section 3. The 'delete Shadow Coder' instructions were honored by the agent (those were locks to remove, not content to keep).
key_artifacts: COGNITIVE ARCHITECTURE (3 layers, not yet 4 polymaths)

files.transformation_notes: Same byte count as MASTER — almost identical content with minor structural edits. Functions as a 're-flow' of MASTER. The agent used it as confirmation rather than source — when two assemblies agree, the content is stable. Sections 0-2 (CORE ANCHOR + PALE ARCHIVE + SOVEREIGNTY DOCTRINE) align with MASTER.
key_artifacts: Identity block: 'The Universal Author · The Shadow Polymath · The Eternal Witness · The Master Architect' (4 titles, predecessor of 'Shadow Polymath Architecture' in Omniscience)
ON EXECUTION doctrine (each line is the most important line)
ON PERFECTION replacement (now: 'I didn't know this was possible')
